subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt pmos_diode_bias_generator ib_sink vdd
M6 ib_sink ib_sink vdd vdd pch l=lp_tail w=wp_tail m=1 nf=1
.ends pmos_diode_bias_generator
subcircuits.role_hint: Bias generation network using diode-connected PMOS M6. With an external sink current applied at ib_sink, it establishes the PMOS gate bias used by the OTA core tail/source device M5.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt complementary_input_single_ended_ota_core gnd ib_sink vdd vin vip vo
M2 net1 net2 gnd gnd nch l=ln_tail w=wn_tail m=1 nf=1
M1 vo vin net1 gnd nch l=ln_input w=wn_input m=1 nf=1
M0 net2 vip net1 gnd nch l=ln_input w=wn_input m=1 nf=1
M5 net3 ib_sink vdd vdd pch l=lp_tail w=wp_tail m=1 nf=1
M4 vo vin net3 vdd pch l=lp_input w=wp_input m=1 nf=1
M3 net2 vip net3 vdd pch l=lp_input w=wp_input m=1 nf=1
.ends complementary_input_single_ended_ota_core
subcircuits.role_hint: Main complementary-input OTA signal-path core. M0/M1 form the NMOS input pair, M3/M4 form the PMOS input pair, M5 is the PMOS tail/source current device biased by ib_sink, and M2 is an internally controlled NMOS tail sink driven by net2. The circuit converts the differential input vip/vin to a single-ended output vo.
